_help: What the autopilot makes next. Edited by the weekly review (and by you). Each day the planner picks a format and a product type using these weights plus how past reels performed (data/learning/arms.json): mostly the best performers, sometimes something new (explore). caps = the price limit shown on the reel for each product type.

typeBoost._note: Seasonal nudges (multiplies the chance of a type). December-February in north India: winter layers.

experiments._help: Each reel gets one variant per dimension, picked the same learning way (better-scoring variants get picked more, others still tried). Add or remove variants freely; weight 0 turns one off.
experiments._voiceover_note: 'on' stays 0 until a free text-to-speech step is built and tested; the weekly review may build it (Gemini TTS) and then give it weight 0.5.

_ramp: Posting ramp: 1/day until 4 Dec, 2/day from 5 Dec (19:17 IST slot), 3/day from 12 Dec (14:17 IST slot). Set rampPaused true to hold at 1/day.

dm._note: Comment-to-DM (scripts/dm.mjs, hourly). Turn enabled on only after a real comment from a non-admin account got the DM; then reels and captions say 'Comment LINK'.
